executiveSummary: Apple is set to unveil new MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays, and the company is also working on fixing Safari's cramped layout on the iPhone Duo. Meanwhile, Apple is reportedly banning AI, non-English speakers, and other projects from being featured on r/opensource. The iPhone Duo is also facing supply chain issues, with some displays cracking seemingly all in the same way.

takeaways.title: New MacBook Pro OLED
takeaways.description: Apple is set to unveil new MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays, marking a significant shift in the company's laptop lineup.

takeaways.title: iPhone Duo issues
takeaways.description: The iPhone Duo is facing supply chain issues, with some displays cracking seemingly all in the same way, and Apple is reportedly considering changes to Safari to fix the issue.

takeaways.title: r/opensource changes
takeaways.description: The mods at r/opensource have banned projects that use AI, making it a challenging platform for developers to share their work.

worthWatching: The integration of AI in various devices and platforms is becoming increasingly important, with companies struggling to balance innovation with practicality.
The r/opensource community's decision to ban AI projects highlights the challenges of adapting to emerging technologies.
engineeringPerspective: The use of OLED displays in new MacBook Pro models presents an exciting opportunity for engineers to explore new display technologies and optimize performance.
The development of new software features, such as AI-powered tools, requires careful consideration of hardware limitations and potential bugs.
The integration of AI in various devices and platforms demands a deep understanding of machine learning algorithms and their impact on user experience.
